remarks: *BEST AND FINAL OFFERS DUE TUESDAY 6/25 4PM*   Welcome to 71 Vincent! This beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom ranch is nestled at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac in one of Stamford's premier neighborhoods. Enjoy the convenience of being within walking distance to downtown Stamford, parks, restaurants, schools, and houses of worship.  Step inside to find a modern kitchen with updated appliances, adjacent breakfast nook, a bright, comfortable family room, and open dining/living room complete with a wood-burning fireplace. The large primary bedroom boasts a newly remodeled en-suite bathroom. Renovations since 2020 have transformed this home with new central air, gas furnace, updated lighting, paint, appliances, and refinished hardwood floors, making it truly move-in ready.  The spacious backyard provides a private retreat, perfect for relaxation or entertaining. Its cul-de-sac location ensures a quiet environment, while easy access to trains and highways makes commuting a breeze. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity - schedule a tour today!
